goal: Deliver GitHub observation polling, event normalization (E1-E11), .imm/state/loop/ lock and state persistence, rebuildLoopState() recovery, and the imm-loop CLI (tick, status, --dry-run) under S1 (D2) of docs/specs/loop-daemon.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Source BR-REQ-1; meet S1 and D2 in docs/specs/loop-daemon.spec.md: imm-loop tick --dry-run and imm-loop status --json normalize GitHub tracker/PR observations into E1-E11 events, persist .imm/state/loop/state.json and daemon.lock with 0600 permissions, refuse concurrent ticks when daemon.lock is held by a live PID, and reconstruct watermarks and active leases via rebuildLoopState() after .imm/state/loop/ deletion without re-dispatching active work.
